notes.title: The Observational Update
notes.notes:
Dear Club Members!

Every day the Mailman delivers tons of letters from you and we are reading them very carefully. Thank you for helping us make the Club better.

Make sure you have downloaded the latest version, as in contains the following bananas:

[h1]Gameplay improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The fridge won’t open if coffee is the only thing you’ve brought from the su•  permarket 
[*] When you reach an ending, the CONTINUE button will pop up only if you click on any of the ending frames. This will prevent you from skipping ending images and missing the outcome.
[/list]
[h1]Localization polishing[/h1]
[h1]Bug fixes and performance improvements[/h1]

Stay tuned for more updates and improvements.

[i]See you,
Primate Observation Club[/i]

P.S. Feeding the monkeys is still prohibited.
